series.name: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference
series.notes: SUBSET of the table: the source document contains 202 numeric alarms across subsystems (Battery Pack, Balancing Module, BMU, RPCB, DCDC, PCS, LTMS, ESU); the 9 rows here are the safety-critical and Pakistan-plausible subset, chosen to fit the brief's code budget. Codes NOT extracted from this same document include the whole liquid-cooling/HVAC sub-plant (see QUARANTINE) and the Balancing Module / BMU / RPCB / DCDC / PCS long tails. This is the ONLY Huawei solar document found that is a dedicated, numbered, subsystem-organised Alarm Reference (202 codes, 3100-3913) - the format the KB brief anticipated. It is C&I/container scale (215 kWh), not the residential LUNA2000-S1, so use it for plant-level work only. Code strings are exactly as printed, e.g. "3100", with sub-variants like "3107-1" implied by Reason ID. Severity is Major/Minor/Warning and Clearance Category is ADAC (auto-clear) or ADMC (manual clear). Liquid-cooling/HVAC sub-plant codes 3620-3725 are QUARANTINED - see QUARANTINE. ALARM ID SPACE COLLISION: 3000-3066 exist in BOTH this document's sibling residential tables and the LUNA2000-S0/S1 tables with completely different meanings (e.g. 3100 here is a battery pack alarm, but 3000-3066 in S0/S1 are ESS module alarms). Do not cross-map.

aliases: Battery Pack and External Power Connected Abnormally

title.en: Battery Pack and External Power Connected Abnormally
title.ur: Battery pack aur external power ka connection abnormal hai

meaning.en: The pack copper bar has overheated, so the pack is locked out of service. ADAC, auto-clears once the bar cools.
meaning.ur: Pack ka copper bar garm ho gaya hai, is liye pack service se lock ho gaya. ADAC - thanda hone par khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: The battery pack copper bar experiences overtemperature.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka copper bar overtemperature jhel raha hai.

causes.en: Loss of cooling that lets the joint run hot - the manual's fix path is a 30-minute quiescent wait followed by a joint inspection, which is a heat-soak diagnosis, not a sensor fault.
causes.ur: Cooling ka loss jis ki wajah se joint garam chalta hai - manual ka ilaaj 30 minute ruke rehne ke baad joint inspection hai, jo heat-soak diagnosis hai, sensor fault nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the ESS is neither charging nor discharging, then wait 30 minutes and check whether the alarm clears.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke ESS na charge ho raha ho na discharge, phir 30 minute intezaar karke check karein ke alarm khatam hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it persists, power off the ESS per the user manual and wait 5 minutes before opening anything.
solutions.ur: Agar bana rahe to user manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein aur kuch kholne se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Wearing PPE, open the pack front panel and check whether the positive and negative copper bars are loose; tighten the screws if so.
solutions.ur: PPE pehn kar pack ka front panel kholein aur check karein ke positive aur negative copper bars loose hain ya nahi; loose hon to screws tighten karein.

solutions.en: Start the ESS on the user interface afterwards; if the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support.
solutions.ur: Uske baad user interface par ESS start karein; alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

meaning.en: Battery current exceeded its upper limit and the protection has engaged. ADMC - must be cleared manually.
meaning.ur: Battery current apni upper limit se upar gaya aur protection chala. ADMC - manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The battery pack current exceeds the upper limit.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka current upper limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Power or communications cables of the ESS incorrectly connected.
causes.ur: ESS ke power ya communications cables galat se connected hain.

solutions.en: Check whether the power and communications cables of the ESS are correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke ESS ke power aur communications cables theek se connected hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If cables are correct, clear the alarm on the user interface and restart the ESS from there.
solutions.ur: Agar cables theek hain to user interface par alarm clear karke wahan se ESS restart karein.

solutions.en: If cables are wrong, correct them per the user manual and repeat the clear-and-restart step.
solutions.ur: Agar cables galat hain to user manual ke mutabiq theek karke clear aur restart dohra dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

title.ur: Battery pack lock ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The pack is locked out, usually after a copper bar or cell insulation problem. ADMC - manual clear required.
meaning.ur: Pack lock out ho gaya hai, aam tor par copper bar ya cell insulation ki kharabi ke baad. ADMC - manual clear zaroori hai.

causes.en: Battery pack copper bar connection is abnormal or the cell has insulation requirements that are not met.
causes.ur: Battery pack copper bar ka connection abnormal hai ya cell ki insulation requirements poori nahi hoti.

causes.en: The same loose positive/negative copper bar root cause as alarm 3100, which this document gives an identical troubleshooting path to.
causes.ur: Alarm 3100 jaisa hi loose positive/negative copper bar root cause, jis ka is document mein bilkul wahi troubleshooting path hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the ESS is neither charging nor discharging, then clear the alarm on the user interface.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke ESS na charge ho raha ho na discharge, phir user interface par alarm clear karein.

solutions.en: If it does not clear, power off the ESS per the manual, wait 5 minutes, and put on protective equipment before opening the pack.
solutions.ur: Agar clear na ho to manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, aur pack kholne se pehle protective equipment pehnein.

solutions.en: Check the positive and negative copper bar screws for looseness and tighten them; re-start from the user interface.
solutions.ur: Positive aur negative copper bar ke screws ki looseness check karke tighten karein; phir user interface se dobara start karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

title.ur: PACK thermal runaway (pack mein aag/smoke ka khatra)

meaning.en: A battery pack has abnormal temperature and poses thermal runaway risk. This is a life-safety event, not a service call.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ka temperature abnormal hai aur thermal runaway ka khatra hai. Yeh zindagi ki safety ka masla hai, service call nahi.

causes.en: The battery pack has abnormal temperature and thermal runaway risk.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka temperature abnormal hai aur thermal runaway ka khatra hai.

causes.en: A cell-level fault such as overvoltage, undervoltage or sampling abnormality.
causes.ur: Cell level fault jaise overvoltage, undervoltage ya sampling abnormality.

solutions.en: Observe the system remotely for 30 minutes. During observation do NOT approach the ESS or open the cabin doors.
solutions.ur: System ko remote 30 minute dekhein. Is dauran ESS ke paas mat jayein aur cabin doors mat kholein.

solutions.en: Watch for other exceptions during that window: abnormal battery voltage, abnormal battery temperature, combustible gas concentration.
solutions.ur: Us window mein baaki exceptions dekhein: abnormal battery voltage, abnormal battery temperature, combustible gas concentration.

solutions.en: If no exception is found in 30 minutes, send trained personnel to observe; if a thermal event is confirmed, evacuate and call emergency services.
solutions.ur: Agar 30 minute mein koi exception nahi mila to trained personnel bhej ke observation karwayein; thermal event confirm ho to evacuate karke emergency services bulayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

meaning.en: The DC-DC converter's liquid cooling has faulted or its I/O self-test failed, so battery temperature cannot be controlled.
meaning.ur: DC-DC converter ki liquid cooling fault ho gayi ya uska I/O self-test fail hua, is liye battery temperature control nahi ho sakti.

causes.en: The DCDC liquid cooling has faulted.
causes.ur: DCDC liquid cooling fault ho gayi hai.

causes.en: The DCDC I/O self-test is abnormal - the manual lists this separately from the cooling fault in the same sentence.
causes.ur: DCDC ka I/O self-test abnormal hai - manual ise usi sentence mein cooling fault se alag list karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual, then check that the DCDC communications port and the RCM CON4 communications port are both securely connected.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein, phir check karein ke DCDC communications port aur RCM ka CON4 communications port dono securely connected hain.

solutions.en: After 5 minutes, power on the ESS per the manual and reset the system on the user interface.
solutions.ur: 5 minute baad manual ke mutabiq ESS power on karke user interface par system reset karein.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support - a cooling fault left unattended overheats the packs.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein - cooling fault ko nazarandaz kiya jaye to packs garm ho jate hain.

aliases: PCS Grid Phase Wire Short-Circuited to PE

title.en: PCS Grid Phase Wire Short-Circuited to PE
title.ur: PCS grid phase wire PE se short ho gayi

meaning.en: An AC output phase wire of the PCS is short-circuited to PE, so the inverter has dropped off-grid.
meaning.ur: PCS ki AC output phase wire PE se short ho gayi hai, is liye inverter grid se utar gaya hai.

causes.en: The AC output phase wire is short-circuited to PE.
causes.ur: AC output phase wire PE se short ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Ages or dust on the AC busbars, which can bridge to earth in humid conditions.
causes.ur: AC busbars par ghisay ya dhool jo humid conditions mein earth se bridge kar sakti hai.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the user manual.
solutions.ur: User manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Turn off the secondary circuit breaker of the transformer and lock it out.
solutions.ur: Transformer ka secondary circuit breaker band karke lock out karein.

solutions.en: Use a megohmmeter to measure impedance between the AC side and ground; if below roughly 100 kOhm, rectify the fault.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se AC side aur ground ke darmiyan impedance measure karein; agar 100 kOhm se kam hai to fault theek karein.

solutions.en: If the impedance is normal, contact technical support rather than re-energising.
solutions.ur: Agar impedance normal hai to dobara energise karne ke bajaye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

title.ur: Low PCS insulation resistance (PCS insulation kam)

meaning.en: The PCS insulation resistance to ground is below the protection threshold, so the unit has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: PCS ka ground ke khilaf insulation resistance protection threshold se kam hai, is liye unit grid se disconnect ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The PCS side is short-circuited to ground.
causes.ur: PCS side ground se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The PCS has operated in a damp environment and insulation between the PCS and ground has degraded.
causes.ur: PCS damp environment mein chala hai aur PCS aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Set the insulation resistance protection threshold on the user interface to the minimum value allowed by the grid standard.
solutions.ur: User interface par insulation resistance protection threshold ko grid standard ke mutabiq minimum value par set karein.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi measurement karne se pehle manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Check that the device PE cable is correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke device ka PE cable correctly connected hai.

solutions.en: Use a megohmmeter to check common-mode insulation, splitting the circuit to locate the low-resistance section.
solutions.ur: Common-mode insulation check karne ke liye megohmmeter use karein aur circuit baant kar kam-resistance hissa dhoondein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

meaning.en: The LTMS electric heater cannot run properly, so the thermal system cannot keep battery temperature in range.
meaning.ur: LTMS ka electric heater theek se nahi chal raha, is liye thermal system battery temperature range mein nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: The cable to the electric heater is loose or damaged.
causes.ur: Electric heater ka cable loose ya damaged hai.

causes.en: The coolant is insufficient, i.e. there is a leak in the LTMS or a pipe.
causes.ur: Coolant kam hai, matlab LTMS ya pipe mein leakage hai.

causes.en: The electric heater itself is faulty.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual first.
solutions.ur: Pehle manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the heater cable is disconnected or broken; if so, reconnect the electric heater connector.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke heater cable disconnect ya toota hai ya nahi; agar haan to electric heater connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Check for leakage in the LTMS or a pipe; if leakage exists, replace the LTMS per the maintenance manual.
solutions.ur: LTMS ya pipe mein leakage check karein; leakage ho to maintenance manual ke mutabiq LTMS badal dein.

solutions.en: If the cable and coolant are proven good, replace the LTMS per the maintenance manual.
solutions.ur: Agar cable aur coolant dono theek nikle to maintenance manual ke mutabiq LTMS badal dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

aliases: High Relative Humidity Inside ESS Cabin

title.en: High Relative Humidity Inside ESS Cabin
title.ur: ESS cabin mein humidity zyada hai (condensation ka khatra)

meaning.en: Cabin relative humidity is high. The system still charges and discharges, but there is a condensation risk.
meaning.ur: Cabin ki relative humidity zyada hai. System ab bhi charge aur discharge ho raha hai, lekin condensation ka khatra hai.

causes.en: ESS doors not completely closed let cabin humidity in - the manual lists door closure as a check alongside LTMS state and temperature control mode.
causes.ur: ESS doors poori tarah band na hon se cabin mein humidity aa rahi hai - manual door closure ko LTMS state aur temperature control mode ke saath hi check batata hai.

solutions.en: Ensure the temperature control mode is set to automatic, not manual.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke temperature control mode automatic par set hai, manual par nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the LTMS is normal and whether the ESS doors are completely closed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LTMS normal hai aur ESS doors poori tarah band hain.

solutions.en: In humid climates, add a door seal inspection and check that the cabinet is not in a shaded pocket trapping vapour.
solutions.ur: Humid climates mein door seal inspection bhi karein aur check karein ke cabinet aise shaded jagah nahi hai jahan vapour atak jaye.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support - condensation on HV terminals is a safety issue.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein - HV terminals par condensation safety ka masla hai.
